request.query: sum norm coefficients over finite set containing support padding zeros

items.name: finsum_def'
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_7} {α : Sort u_8} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M),
  finsum f = if h : (Function.support (f ∘ PLift.down)).Finite then ∑ i ∈ h.toFinset, f i.down else 0

items.name: finsum_mem_eq_sum
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] (f : α → M) {s : Set α} (hf : (s ∩ Function.support f).Finite),
  ∑ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ s), f i = ∑ i ∈ hf.toFinset, f i

items.name: Finsupp.sum_fintype
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_2 : Fintype α]
  (f : α →₀ M) (g : α → M → N), (∀ (i : α), g i 0 = 0) → f.sum g = ∑ i, g i (f i)

items.name: finsum
items.type: {M : Type u_7} → {α : Sort u_8} → [AddCommMonoid M] → (α → M) → M

items.name: Fintype.sum_subset
items.type:
∀ {M : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_7} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → M},
  (∀ (i : ι), f i ≠ 0 → i ∈ s) → ∑ i ∈ s, f i = ∑ i, f i

items.name: Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] (f : α →₀ M) {s : Finset α},
  f.support ⊆ s → ∀ (g : α → M → N), (∀ i ∈ s, g i 0 = 0) → f.sum g = ∑ x ∈ s, g x (f x)

items.name: Finsupp.onFinset_sum
tsum_eq_sum'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace α] {f : β → α}
  {L : SummationFilter β} [L.LeAtTop] {s : Finset β}, Function.support f ⊆ ↑s → ∑'[L] (b : β), f b = ∑ b ∈ s, f b
